text:
melissa_cs: Heads-up: NovelHealth opened a high-severity escalation. They report a sudden drop in retrieval/rerank quality right after our midday deploy. Examples show missing guideline citations and irrelevant top docs. Asked for fast triage/rollback.

deploy-bot: deployment v2-rerank-2026-03-17 promoted to prod at 2026-03-17T10:12:43Z by aj_eng :rocket:

melissa_cs: Their repro (copied):
```
user: \"Which medications are contraindicated during pregnancy for condition Y?\"
expected: guideline pages, trial summaries, explicit pregnancy sections, high-recall docs.
actual top-3:
1) general product FAQ (score 0.83)
2) unrelated blog post (score 0.74)
3) marketing overview (score 0.63)
no guideline citations in top 10.
```

emma_ps: Did we change the index or embeddings? Customer says problem started ~10:15 UTC.

aj_eng: Deploy included a new reranker binary + removal of an old tie-breaker heuristic. No index rebuilds, embeddings unchanged on our side.

ryan_ml: The reranker used expanded web crawl training + synthetic augmentation. We also flipped on a contextual-reweight experiment flag that biases against near-duplicate anchors. That could deprioritize clinical guideline text.

aj_eng: If their traffic is routed through A/B we can isolate. Otherwise recommend immediate rollback of the experiment and restore tie-breaker to confirm. Can do in ~15m.

melissa_cs: NovelHealth wants rollback ASAP. I've attached 6 failing queries to SUP-4521.

ryan_ml: I'll run an offline eval: the 6 queries + a 500-sample health slice from their namespace. Need index snapshot and scoring traces for 10:00-10:30UTC. aj_eng can you export?

aj_eng: Exporting snapshot -> s3://redwood-prod-snapshots/novelhealth/2026-03-17/. Grabbing model trace logs now. Also confirming embedding model id (no change).

aj_eng: Note: ranking config diff shows removal of tie-breaker and experiment flag enabled. No vectorizer changes.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-4521 assigned to customer-success (melissa_cs), severity: high, SLA: 4h.

melissa_cs: Customer approved rollback if it helps, ask them to hold steady.

aj_eng: Rolling back experiment flag + reinstating tie-breaker at 2026-03-17T10:52:11Z. Will monitor top-k results and error rates.

deploy-bot: feature-contextual-reweighting disabled for reranker; tie-breaker heuristic restored. Changes live at 2026-03-17T10:52:11Z.

melissa_cs: NovelHealth reports partial recovery: 4 of 6 failing queries look correct now (within ~6 minutes). They still want an RCA and longer validation window.

ryan_ml: I'll produce feature-level deltas for the 6 queries and compute precision@5/recall@10 on the 500-sample slice for both models. Will upload to SUP-4521 by EOD with a hypothesis about contextual reweighting penalizing clinical anchor terms.

emma_ps: Good catch. Let's keep the ticket open until the RCA. Also plan a controlled rollout/monitor prior to next reranker push.

melissa_cs: Closing the immediate customer-facing pain but keeping internal follow-up. I'll run 30-min check-ins with the customer until EOD. Thanks everyone.
